items.title: As ‘change bloc’ falls far short of majority, Democrats’ Golan urges coalition with Arabs
items.summary: Joint List chairman says he's ready to 'pave the way' for Netanyahu's ouster; with 84.5% of votes counted, PM's bloc on track to win 54 seats, Eisenkot's 51, and Arab parties 17

items.title: Praevar Expands Podium Series with New Display Technologies
items.summary: Praevar announced that it has expanded its Podium Series with the introduction of two new display technologies – Podium dvLED and the Podium eLuminex ePoster powered by E Ink Kaleido 3 technology. Praevar said that these additions join the Podium DS and Podium High-Brightness Low
